notes.title: Patch Notes | July 2025
notes.content: [h3]Patch notes & Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Increased the range for the master branch audio bus.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted lighting in the convenience store.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a consistent camera position during a cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of a readable note for easier interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a failsafe for an occasional achievement sync issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a wider range for the mouse sensitivity slider.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a failsafe to ensure smooth camera movement during cutscenes. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a failsafe to automatically remove items from the inventory when required. [/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced NPC walking animations for smoother and more natural movement. [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved mouse size issues, ensuring proper scaling on smaller screen resolutions. [/p][/*][*][p]Applied multiple optimizations to audio levels based on player distance.[/p][/*][/list]
